title: LAMP in situ complete
author: Nicholas W. West
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.57cg9iw
materials: Can be held overnight in paraffin
For colorimeteric detection add 0.15 µL of digoxigenin-11-dUTP, 25nmol (25uL) from Roche, this replaces a portion of the H2O in the reaction mix
For fluorescent detection procced to step 43

steps.title: Tissue Fixation and Vacuum Infiltration
steps.instruction: Harvest tissue and submerge in an excess of FAA solution.

substeps.instruction: Pull a vacuum for ~2 min and agitate samples gently.
Hold under vacuum for 2-3 min before slowly releasing vacuum.
If tissue samples float after vacuum release, agitate gently and repeat the vacuum step if necessary.

steps.title: Initial Dehydration and Incubation
steps.instruction: Perform initial ethanol washes and cold incubation.

substeps.instruction: Perform 2 washes in 50% EtOH, 5 min per wash.
Incubate samples at 4 °C for 10 to 14 hours.
Perform 2 washes in 50% EtOH, 30 min per wash.

steps.title: Graded Ethanol Dehydration
steps.instruction: Dehydrate samples through an increasing ethanol gradient at 60 °C.

substeps.instruction: Incubate 10 min in 75% EtOH at 60 °C (samples can be held here overnight at 4 °C).
Incubate 10 min in 85% EtOH at 60 °C.
Incubate 10 min in 95% EtOH at 60 °C.
Perform 2 washes in 100% EtOH, 10 min per wash at 60 °C.

steps.title: Clearing and Paraffin Infiltration
steps.instruction: Clear tissues using a graded series of EtOH and Histoclear (or xylenes) and infiltrate with paraffin at 60 °C.

substeps.instruction: Incubate 10 min in 3:1 EtOH (100%) : Histoclear (or xylenes) at 60 °C.
Incubate 10 min in 1:1 EtOH (100%) : Histoclear (or xylenes) at 60 °C.
Incubate 10 min in 1:3 EtOH (100%) : Histoclear (or xylenes) at 60 °C.
Incubate 5 min in Histoclear (or xylenes) at 60 °C.
Incubate 10 min in 1:1 Histoclear (or xylenes) : Paraffin at 60 °C.
Perform 5 washes in paraffin at 60 °C, 30 min per wash.

steps.title: Tissue Embedding
steps.instruction: Embed tissue in paraffin molds using a heating element/oven.

substeps.instruction: Place tissue molds and tweezers/tools in oven.
Transfer tissue into pre-warmed tissue molds, fill with paraffin, and align samples in desired orientation.
Wait for bubbles to disperse (use gentle agitation if desired).
Remove molds from oven and allow to cool.

steps.title: Sectioning and Mounting
steps.instruction: Section tissue using a microtome and mount on slides.

substeps.instruction: Use initial sections to adjust microtome for ribboning.
Reduce number of sections per slide when approaching the area of interest.
Float section ribbon on 45 °C diH2O and capture on slide, leaving a wide margin around the sample.

steps.title: Deparaffinization and Rehydration
steps.instruction: Remove paraffin and rehydrate slides through a graded series of solvents.

substeps.instruction: Incubate slides in Histoclear (or xylenes) for 10 min at 55 °C.
Perform 3 washes of Histoclear (or xylenes) at 55 °C for 5 min per wash.
Perform 3 washes of 100% EtOH at 55 °C for 2 min per wash.
Incubate 2 min in 95% EtOH.
Incubate 2 min in 70% EtOH.
Incubate 2 min in 50% EtOH.
Incubate 2 min in DEPC H2O.
Incubate 2 min in 1xTBS.

steps.title: Proteinase K Treatment
steps.instruction: Permeabilize tissue using Proteinase K buffer.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Proteinase K buffer (1xTE, 0.5% Triton-x-100, 20ug/uL Proteinase K), vortexing before adding Proteinase K.
Remove slide, drain excess buffer, and outline tissue with hydrophobic pen/wax pencil.
Add 250 µL Proteinase K buffer to each slide and place in humidity chamber at 37 °C for 20 min.
Wash 3 times with 1xTBS for 5 min per wash.

steps.title: Genomic DNA Removal (RNA Detection Only)
steps.instruction: Remove genomic background if detecting RNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 40 µL DNase I reaction per slide according to Thermo Scientific instructions.
Apply DNase I reaction mix drop-wise onto tissue sections, pitching and rolling the slide to ensure coverage.
Place slide in humidity chamber and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour.
Gently pitch and roll the humidity chamber every 5-7 min to prevent pooling.
Wash 3 times in 1xTBS, 5 min per wash.

steps.title: LAMP Reaction
steps.instruction: Perform the LAMP reaction on the tissue sections.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 30 µL LAMP reaction per slide according to New England Biosciences instructions (use fluorescently labeled loop primer mixture for fluorescent detection).
Apply the desired LAMP reaction (colorimetric or fluorescent) mix drop-wise to tissue samples, pitching and rolling the slide for uniform distribution.
Place in humidity chamber and incubate for an empirically determined time (typically 30 min to 1 hour).
Gently pitch and roll the humidity chamber every 5-7 min during incubation to avoid pooling.
Perform 2 washes in 1xMAB, 5 min per wash.

steps.title: Immunodetection and Visualization
steps.instruction: Detect the LAMP product using anti-DIG antibodies and NBT/BCIP.

substeps.instruction: Incubate slides in 1xBlocking buffer with gentle rocking at room temperature for 1 hour.
Flood slide with 250 µL of a 1:5000 anti-DIG alkaline phosphatase conjugated antibody in 1xBlocking buffer, place in humidity chamber, and incubate at room temperature for 1 hour.
Wash 5 times in 1xMAB, 5 min per wash.
Flood slides with 250 µL NBT/BCIP and incubate at room temperature until reaction develops (typically 20-30 min).
Stop reaction by flooding slides with diH2O and mount a slide cover.
